title: One-step logarithmic potential bound for Hedge
statement:
Fix $N \ge 1$ experts and $T$ rounds, a learning rate $\eta > 0$, and a valid loss sequence $\ell$, so that $0 \le \ell_t(i) \le 1$ for every round $t$ and expert $i$. Writing $W_t = \sum_{i=1}^N \exp\!\bigl(-\eta L_t(i)\bigr)$ for the Hedge potential and $\widehat{\ell}_t = \sum_{i=1}^N p_t(i)\,\ell_t(i)$ for the expected loss under the Hedge distribution, the one-round change in log-potential is controlled by the expected loss: for each round $t$,
\[
  \ln W_{t+1} - \ln W_t \;\le\; -\bigl(1 - e^{-\eta}\bigr)\,\widehat{\ell}_t.
\]
replaced:
For a valid loss sequence, $\eta > 0$, and $t < T$,
\[
  \ln W_{t+1} - \ln W_t \;\le\; -(1 - e^{-\eta})\,\widehat{\ell}_t,
\]
which follows from $\ln(1-x) \le -x$ applied to the potential ratio bound.
